simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֶלְתּוֹלַד (H513) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֶלְתּוֹלַד (ʼEltôwlad) means Eltolad , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 15 30.

definitions.full: H513. Eltolad אֶלְתּוֺלַד proper name, of a location (compare תּוֺלַד below ילד ) city in southern Judah Josh 15:30 ; 19:4 ; compare also תּוֺלָ֑ד (q. v.) 1Chr 4:29 .
definitions.rootNote: probably from 410 and a masculine form of 8435 (compare 8434 ); God (is) generator;
